**Finding: COMPLIANT** (at/above the preferred position) — no redline proposed.

MSL's warranty package works in IBM's favour:

- **Express warranty (SOW § 19.1):** Products, MSL-supplied materials/Parts and work will conform in all material respects to IBM specifications and be of specified quality, good workmanship and free from defect; periods run from delivery, survive acceptance testing, and expressly cover latent defects from MSL's specification, workmanship, process and supplier parts.
- **Remedy (§ 19.5):** failure analysis, repair or replacement at MSL's expense within the stated turnaround, and a refund of MSL's price (plus Parts prices) where repair/replacement is not possible — the full repair/replace/refund ladder.
- **Bonus:** § 19.7 epidemic-failure clause puts Product Recall costs on MSL, which exceeds the playbook's preferred position.
- **Disclaimer does not swallow it:** § 19.6 is limited to implied and other quality/fitness terms and expressly preserves MSL's Section 19 obligations. No "AS IS" language anywhere.

Noted for the deal team (not deviations): the warranty durations in 19.1(a)(iv)–(v) are redacted, so confirm they are at least 12 months; and § 16.19 sunsets all representations and warranties on an anniversary of the Effective Date — worth confirming that does not truncate Product warranties for units delivered late in the term. Missing services/compliance-with-laws/malicious-code warranties are immaterial in this Products manufacturing context.
